title: NGOBase Scraper
description: Collect public NGO, charity, and nonprofit listings from NGOBase using a keyword or location and work-area filters.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search NGO names and public listing text. Takes priority over location and work-area filters.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country name or NGOBase country code, for example United States or US. Used when no keyword is supplied.

state.title: State or province
state.description: Optional state or province name/code. A country is required when using this field.

city.title: City
city.description: Optional city name or NGOBase city value. A country is required when using this field.

workArea.title: Work area
workArea.description: Work area name or NGOBase code, for example Health or HLT.

subWorkArea.title: Sub work area
subWorkArea.description: Optional sub work area name or NGOBase code. A work area is recommended.

resultsWanted.title: Results wanted
resultsWanted.description: Maximum number of unique NGO records to save.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Maximum listing pages to request for the selected search target.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy configuration for reliable runs.
